update.column: select distinct '800139398-6' AS "Nit de empresa", TO_CHAR(mlt.transaction_date , 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "Fecha de causación del honorario", mchc.collection_nit AS "Nit casa de cobro", mchc.collection_code as "Código casa de cobro", coalesce(hono.amt, 0) + coalesce(vat.amt, 0) as "Valor del honorario", coalesce(hono.amt, 0) AS "Valor base", coalesce(vat.amt, 0) AS "Valor IVA", COALESCE(cce."NIT", ccp."Cedula") AS "Cédula del cliente", ml.id AS "Crédito del cliente", coalesce(delinquent_paid_amounts.overdue_amount,0) + coalesce(delinquent_paid_amounts.penaly_paid,0) - coalesce(hono.amt, 0) - coalesce(vat.amt, 0) AS "Valor porción morosa del pago", coalesce(delinquent_paid_amounts.penaly_paid,0) AS "Valor interés de mora pagado", coalesce(delinquent_paid_amounts.overdue_non_penalty_amount, 0) - coalesce(hono.amt, 0) - coalesce(vat.amt, 0) AS "Valor de las cuotas morosas pagadas" from m_loan ml join m_loan_repayment_schedule mlrs on mlrs.loan_id = ml.id join m_loan_transaction mlt on mlt.loan_id = ml.id join m_client mc on mc.id = ml.client_id left join m_collection_house_configuration mchc on mchc.id = mlt.collection_house_id LEFT JOIN campos_cliente_empresas cce ON cce.client_id = mc.id LEFT JOIN campos_cliente_persona ccp ON ccp.client_id = mc.id join m_loan_charge mlc on mlc.loan_id = ml.id and mlc.is_penalty = false and mlc.charge_calculation_enum = 1009 left join( select mlt2.id, mlt2.loan_id, sum(coalesce(mltrsm.principal_portion_derived,0) + coalesce(mltrsm.interest_portion_derived,0) + coalesce(mltrsm.fee_charges_portion_derived,0)) AS overdue_non_penalty_amount, sum(coalesce(mltrsm.penalty_charges_portion_derived,0)) AS penaly_paid, sum(coalesce(mltrsm.principal_portion_derived,0) + coalesce(mltrsm.interest_portion_derived,0) + coalesce(mltrsm.fee_charges_portion_derived,0)) overdue_amount from m_loan_transaction_repayment_schedule_mapping mltrsm join m_loan_repayment_schedule mlrs2 on mlrs2.id = mltrsm.loan_repayment_schedule_id join m_loan_transaction mlt2 on mlt2.id = mltrsm.loan_transaction_id and mlt2.transaction_date > mlrs2.duedate group by mlt2.id, mlt2.loan_id ) delinquent_paid_amounts on delinquent_paid_amounts.loan_id = ml.id and delinquent_paid_amounts.id = mlt.id left join( select mlt2.id, mlt2.loan_id, sum(coalesce(mltrsm.principal_portion_derived,0) + coalesce(mltrsm.interest_portion_derived,0) + coalesce(mltrsm.fee_charges_portion_derived,0)) due_amount from m_loan_transaction_repayment_schedule_mapping mltrsm join m_loan_repayment_schedule mlrs2 on mlrs2.id = mltrsm.loan_repayment_schedule_id join m_loan_transaction mlt2 on mlt2.id = mltrsm.loan_transaction_id and mlt2.transaction_date <= mlrs2.duedate group by mlt2.id, mlt2.loan_id ) non_delinquent_paid_amounts on non_delinquent_paid_amounts.loan_id = ml.id and non_delinquent_paid_amounts.id = mlt.id join ( select mlcp.loan_transaction_id, mlcp.loan_charge_id, sum(coalesce(mlcp.amount,0)) amt from m_loan_charge_paid_by mlcp group by mlcp.loan_transaction_id, mlcp.loan_charge_id ) hono on hono.loan_transaction_id = mlt.id and hono.loan_charge_id = mlc.id left join ( select vat.loan_id, vat_paid.loan_transaction_id, vat_charge.parent_charge_id, sum(coalesce(vat_paid.amount,0)) amt from m_loan_charge vat join m_charge vat_charge on vat_charge.id = vat.charge_id and vat_charge.parent_charge_id is not null join m_loan_charge_paid_by vat_paid on vat_paid.loan_charge_id = vat.id where vat.charge_calculation_enum = 342 group by vat.loan_id, vat_paid.loan_transaction_id, vat_charge.parent_charge_id ) vat on vat.loan_id = ml.id and vat.loan_transaction_id = mlt.id and vat.parent_charge_id = mlc.charge_id where mlt.transaction_type_enum = 2 and mlt.is_reversed = false and mlt.transaction_date between '${startDate}' and '${endDate}' and (mchc.collection_nit = '${collectionNit}' or '${collectionNit}' = '-1') and (mchc.collection_code = '${collectionCode}' or '${collectionCode}' = '-1')
